fields.cover_sub: You'd rather be ignored than seen as spam.
fields.step1_body:
Spam lands on someone busy.
A reply lands on someone asking.
Same words. Different room.
So it starts with
where you reply.
fields.step2_body:
Look for "any tool for..."
or "how do you handle..."
No question, no reply.
Then read how they said it.
fields.step3_body:
Say their problem back
in the words they used.
They feel heard first.
Then they want the answer.
fields.step4_body:
Tell them what you'd do.
Name other tools that work too.
Honest beats complete.
Your app comes last.
fields.step5_body:
One line, at the end.
As one option, not the answer.
If it fits, they'll find you.
If not, you still helped.
